rendered: Among the aluminium-based coatings in Table 5[1], the highest Li-ion diffusivity is for lithiated amorphous alumina, Li3.5Al2 O3 (am)[2], with a value of 7.1 ×10^− 10[3] cm^2/s at 300[4] K. By comparison, amorphous Al2O3 Al2 O3 (am)[5] has a diffusivity of 5.94 ×10^− 17[6] cm^2/s at 300[7] K. So the lithiated amorphous coating is several orders of magnitude faster for Li-ion diffusion than amorphous Al2O3.
